# ZEB-ALPHA

> Premium Streetwear, 100% Combed Cotton Polos & 0% Commission Fashion Marketplace

## Overview
ZEBALPHA (https://zebalpha.shop) is a direct-to-consumer apparel brand and transparent multi-vendor fashion platform headquartered in India. We engineer heavyweight luxury streetwear essentials including 100% combed cotton zip polos, 240+ GSM oversized t-shirts, and heavyweight hoodies.

We also operate the Zebalpha Seller Hub, empowering independent fashion makers and clothing manufacturers with a 0% commission marketplace model.

## Navigation & Core Resources
- Storefront: https://zebalpha.shop
- All Products: https://zebalpha.shop/products
- New Releases: https://zebalpha.shop/new-drops
- Premium Store: https://zebalpha.shop/premium-store
- Supplier Hub (0% Commission Seller Portal): https://seller.zebalpha.shop/register
- Editorial & Insights (Blogs): https://zebalpha.shop/blogs
- Contact Support: https://zebalpha.shop/contact

## Apparel Specifications
- Fabrics: 100% long-staple combed cotton, Supima cotton blends
- GSM Tiers: 220-280 GSM heavyweight streetwear knits
- Styling: Custom die-cast metallic zip pulls, reinforced collar ribs, drop-shoulder silhouettes
- Shipping: Pan-India express delivery with real-time tracking
- Payouts: 0% marketplace commission with 100% revenue retention for verified sellers
